sources.title: London View Management Framework
sources.verified_claim: The London Plan protects designated strategic views through the LVMF; protected vistas and detailed management guidance require proposal-specific visual analysis.

sources.title: London View Management Framework high-resolution files
sources.verified_claim: GLA publishes management-plan and protected-vista material; document availability is not an exact candidate intersection finding.

sources.title: London View Management Framework - Mayor's Question Time 2023
sources.verified_claim: GLA explains Policies HC3 and HC4 protect 27 designated strategic views and landmarks; policy context still requires site/proposal analysis.

sources.title: Strategic Views of London
sources.verified_claim: Strategic views are a cross-boundary three-dimensional skyline management tool; they influence tall-building assessment but do not establish candidate height capacity.

sources.title: Protected Vistas (Viewing Corridor) GIS layer
sources.verified_claim: The official polygon layer maps viewing corridors and states proposals affecting designated views need analysis; exact parcel intersection still needs geometric query.

sources.title: Protected Vistas (Extension) GIS layer
sources.verified_claim: GLA states GIS boundaries are indicative and relevant borough confirmation is needed; the layer cannot be treated as exact legal geometry without cross-check.

sources.title: Planning Data Map all layers and tables
sources.verified_claim: The official service exposes Protected Vistas and related planning layers, while its metadata preserves indicative-boundary limitations.

sources.title: DD2662 London View Management Framework London Plan Guidance funding allocation
sources.verified_claim: The GLA funded a review of LVMF guidance and associated tools; a review programme is not silently treated as adopted replacement guidance or candidate-specific clearance.
